access_statement.statement: Only the frozen WA brief, WA inputs and own pass-B outputs/derivatives were opened for task data. No network, other-pass/state/shared-candidate/repo-doc/git access or exposure. Local system executables/libraries used under the brief exception. Every possibly opened or created path is listed in the conservative allowed-path inventory.

tools_used.name: Python3 standard library
tools_used.uses: Read-only original/hash/length verification; HTMLParser native text, JSON/schema/link/tuple audits; append-only labels/completions/progress. No external parser or network.

tools_used.name: Swift/macOS PDFKit/CoreGraphics local extract/render executables
tools_used.uses: Native text for every supplied PDF page; recursive XObject image detection; render derivatives inside own output. For every partial PDF, view all named failure pages plus every page with native text under200 characters or an embedded image object; remaining pages read as native text. text_layer none images viewed in full. Each partial HTML retained image viewed; final audit found no unretained required external images.

tools_used.name: view_image
tools_used.uses: Every required rendered page/retained image actually viewed singly, one image per call; per-entry notes and rendered-view log distinguish rendering from viewing. No OCR substituted for viewing.

tools_used.name: sips and local system command probes
tools_used.uses: Local image metadata/conversion/navigation aids; no installs.

tools_used.name: rg/local file readers
tools_used.uses: Only own outputs/scripts and allowed inputs. Full native page bodies and exhaustive token comparison blocks read sequentially; common unchanged text depends on its fully read authoritative/reference body. No keyword-only body classification.
